source: model/醒狮_保留UV_三角转四边_优化.blend
geometry_status: Full lion with real named body/head submeshes; eyes are painted into the main head mesh and are not independent geometry.
compatibility: Source header is Blender 5.1; Blender 5.0.0 reads it with a newer-version warning. Source is never saved by this script.

source_provenance.part_partition_status: Custom properties describe spatial/UV color selection of existing source triangles, uncapped cuts, and unreconstructed topology; named parts are appearance partitions, not complete craft internals or rigged joints.
source_provenance.ai_provenance_status: No explicit Lux3D/AI provider attribution was found in the inspected scene/object/mesh/material custom properties. Do not infer the new model generation method from generic asset IDs.
material_inference: Color-derived PBR only; not measured textile or recovered embroidery

duplicate_verification.criteria: Exact positions, indices, polygon lengths, smooth flags, per-face material indices, every UV layer, numeric world transform, shader node input values/links/settings, and packed texture bytes (material names ignored).

hair_approximation.method: Deterministic sampled centerlines become double-sided ribbon meshes; normalized radii use each source object fiber_world_radius_max (about 0.14–0.16 mm), and muzzle radii keep source world units.
